SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-111793                       
  Webtop: Document Transcoder Flaw      
                                        
  An improper sphere resource transfer  
  bug allows authenticated attackers to 
  bypass conversion guards and process  
  arbitrary files. CISA adds flaw to KEV
  list due to active exploitation risks.
